name: AssetDeliveryProfileBlock
description: Defines a delivery profile block, including start and end time, days of the week, duration, delivery capacity and price time interval quantity.

dayOfWeek.description: The days of the week of the delivery.

deliveryCapacity.description: The number of units included in the transaction for each delivery interval

endTime.description: The end time of the delivery interval for each block or shape.

priceTimeIntervalQuantity.description: Price per quantity per delivery time interval.

startTime.description: The start time of the delivery interval for each block or shape.
